purpose: Ask a governor to ship goods to the Crown

options.text: on the Crown's business, which is now yours
with a good deal of confidence in you
with less time than the matter deserves
having had to write it twice already

steps.prompt: What the Crown will pay for it

options.label: pay double — call the shipment vital
options.text: Set aside {param:amount} of {param:resource} for the Crown. This is vital, and the Treasury will pay twice over for it — the gold is yours, for the town, and I do not want to hear it went anywhere else{insert:warmth}.

warmth.pleased: . You will know better than I do where it is wanted

options.label: pay a fair price
options.text: Set aside {param:amount} of {param:resource} for the Crown. The Treasury will pay for it, and I have seen to it that the sum is not an insult.

options.label: pay nothing at all
options.text: Set aside {param:amount} of {param:resource} for the Crown. There is no money for it{insert:apology}. I am aware of what I am asking.

apology.desperate: , and I have stopped pretending otherwise

tone.annoyed: I shall expect word that it is under way.
